reference_owner: Implementation author source-reading and reproducible scope checks; not externally blinded adjudication

classes.supported: The cited passage entails the complete source-reported dated proposition within its entity/geography/state scope
classes.unsupported_as_cited: A material claim element is absent, contradicted, changed, or attributed to the wrong entity/time/scope; does not mean false in the world
classes.indeterminate: Interpretation, missing context, unresolved conflict/supersession or independent corroboration prevents a defensible decision

strict_release: No reference label or fixture may authorise production/canonical publication
freeze_order: References and rubric written and hashed before executing calibration; dataset/reference changes require a new version
limits: Small authored sample; development author also authors references
Held-out cases are separated from adapter development but not externally blinded
Selected authority passages are source reports, not independent proof of real-world outcomes
Freshness, rights and policy checks may withhold a source-supported claim; report separately
